component.name: MediaNest
component.summary: Keep your photos and videos safe and organised

description.p: MediaNest is a calm home for your photos and videos. It copies them from cameras, phones and folders into one library on your disk, sorted by the date they were taken, and checks every copy byte for byte before anything else happens.

ul.li: A fast timeline that stays smooth with hundreds of thousands of items
Albums, smart albums from a search, tags, ratings and favorites
Search by place, camera, tag, date or words, with suggestions
Places on a map, named offline
HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL, RAW previews, videos and Live Photos
A review inbox for photos without a date, missing files and duplicates
Regular checks for silent damage, and backups of the catalog
Linked folders that are shown without being copied

description.p: Your originals are never modified. Edits such as dates, rotation and tags live in the catalog and can be exported.
